1: // Simple endless runner based on IDEA.md
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: (() => { // Enhanced graphics version
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const width = canvas.width = 800;
7:   const height = canvas.height = 200;
8: 
9:   // Audio setup
10:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
11:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
12:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
13:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
14:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
15:     osc.type = 'sine';
16:     osc.connect(gain);
17:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
18:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime);
19:     osc.start();
20:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
21:   }
22:   function playJumpSound() { playTone(440, 0.1); }
23:   function playGameOverSound() { playTone(150, 0.5); }
24: 
25:   // Player definition
26:   const player = {
27:     // Draw with simple eyes
28:     draw() {
29:       // body
30:       ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
31:       ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.w, this.h);
32:       // eyes
33:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
34:       const eyeSize = 4;
35:       ctx.fillRect(this.x + 6, this.y + 6, eyeSize, eyeSize);
36:       ctx.fillRect(this.x + this.w - 10, this.y + 6, eyeSize, eyeSize);
37:     },
38:     x: 50,
39:     y: height - 40,
40:     w: 30,
41:     h: 30,
42:     vy: 0,
43:     jumpStrength: -8,
44:     gravity: 0.4,
45:     onGround: true,
46:     update() {
47:       this.vy += this.gravity;
48:       this.y += this.vy;
49:       if (this.y + this.h >= height) {
50:         this.y = height - this.h;
51:         this.vy = 0;
52:         this.onGround = true;
53:       } else {
54:         this.onGround = false;
55:       }
56:     },
57: jump() {
58:         if (this.onGround) {
59:           this.vy = this.jumpStrength;
60:           this.onGround = false;
61:           playJumpSound();
62:         }
63:       }
64:   };
65: 
66:   // Input handling
67:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
68:     if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'ArrowUp') player.jump();
69:   });
70: 
71:   // Obstacles
72:   const obstacles = [];
73:   // Cloud objects for background
74:   const clouds = [];
75:   const cloudSpeed = 0.5;
76:   const obstacleSpeed = 3;
77:   const spawnInterval = 120; // frames
78:   let frameCount = 0;
79:   function spawnObstacle() {
80:     // existing obstacle spawning logic
81:     const type = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'spike' : 'gap';
82:     if (type === 'spike') {
83:       const size = 20 + Math.random() * 20;
84:       obstacles.push({ x: width, y: height - size, w: size, h: size, type: 'spike' });
85:     } else {
86:       const gapWidth = 30 + Math.random() * 30;
87:       obstacles.push({ x: width + gapWidth, y: height, w: gapWidth, h: 0, type: 'gap' });
88:     }
89:   }
90: 
91:   // Spawn a simple cloud object
92:   function spawnCloud() {
93:     const r = 20 + Math.random() * 15; // radius
94:     const y = 30 + Math.random() * 50; // vertical position
95:     clouds.push({ x: width + r, y, r });
96:   }
97:     const type = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'spike' : 'gap';
98:     if (type === 'spike') {
99:       const size = 20 + Math.random() * 20;
100:       obstacles.push({ x: width, y: height - size, w: size, h: size, type: 'spike' });
101:     } else {
102:       const gapWidth = 30 + Math.random() * 30;
103:       obstacles.push({ x: width + gapWidth, y: height, w: gapWidth, h: 0, type: 'gap' });
104:     }
105:   }
106: 
107:   // Collision detection
108:   function checkCollision(ob) {
109:     if (ob.type === 'spike') {
110:       return !(player.x + player.w < ob.x || player.x > ob.x + ob.w || player.y + player.h < ob.y || player.y > ob.y + ob.h);
111:     }
112:     // gaps are handled by checking if player is over void
113:     if (ob.type === 'gap') {
114:       const overGap = player.x + player.w > ob.x && player.x < ob.x + ob.w;
115:       const onGround = player.y + player.h >= height;
116:       return overGap && onGround;
117:     }
118:     return false;
119:   }
120: 
121:   let gameOver = false;
122:   let score = 0;
123: 
124:   function update() {
125:     if (gameOver) return;
126:     frameCount++;
127:     // Spawn obstacles and clouds at intervals
128:     if (frameCount % spawnInterval === 0) spawnObstacle();
129:     if (frameCount % 200 === 0) spawnCloud();
130:     player.update();
131:     // Move obstacles
132:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
133:       const ob = obstacles[i];
134:       ob.x -= obstacleSpeed;
135:       if (checkCollision(ob)) { gameOver = true; playGameOverSound(); }
136:       // Remove off‑screen obstacles
137:       if (ob.x + ob.w < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
138:     }
139:     // Move clouds (parallax)
140:     for (let i = clouds.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
141:       const c = clouds[i];
142:       c.x -= cloudSpeed;
143:       if (c.x + c.r < 0) clouds.splice(i, 1);
144:     }
145:     score++;
146:   }
147: 
148:   function draw() {
149:     // Sky gradient background
150:     const skyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
151:     skyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#87ceeb'); // light blue
152:     skyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#b0e0e6'); // lighter near ground
153:     ctx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
154:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
155: 
156:     // Simple moving clouds
157:     clouds.forEach(c => {
158:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
159:       ctx.beginPath();
160:       ctx.arc(c.x, c.y, c.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
161:       ctx.fill();
162:     });
163: 
164:     // Ground with gradient
165:     const groundGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, height - 10, 0, height);
166:     groundGrad.addColorStop(0, '#654321');
167:     groundGrad.addColorStop(1, '#4b2e2e');
168:     ctx.fillStyle = groundGrad;
169:     ctx.fillRect(0, height - 10, width, 10);
170: 
171:     // Draw player with simple pixel‑art style (body + eyes)
172:     player.draw();
173: 
174:     // Draw obstacles
175:     obstacles.forEach(ob => {
176:       if (ob.type === 'spike') {
177:         // draw triangle spike
178:         ctx.fillStyle = '#c33';
179:         ctx.beginPath();
180:         ctx.moveTo(ob.x, ob.y + ob.h);
181:         ctx.lineTo(ob.x + ob.w / 2, ob.y);
182:         ctx.lineTo(ob.x + ob.w, ob.y + ob.h);
183:         ctx.closePath();
184:         ctx.fill();
185:       }
186:     });
187: 
188:     // Score overlay
189:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
190:     ctx.font = '16px monospace';
191:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
192: 
193:     // Game over overlay
194:     if (gameOver) {
195:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
196:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
197:       ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
198:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
199:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
200:     }
201:   }
202: 
203:   function loop() {
204:     update();
205:     draw();
206:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
207:   }
208:   loop();
209: })();
